_doc: The Find Me Money campaign's Revenue OS settings: which functions are on, where each starts from in this pack, and what each waits on. Names of things only. Check with python3 tools/check_campaign.py campaigns/find-me-money/campaign.json.

grok.account: one Grok account for both campaigns

offer: Education first on how business funding really works, then the funding itself: the right product for the project, kept in-house or passed to one partner for a percentage
icp: People and business owners looking for financing, the creative and alternative ways included; wholesalers; local businesses; the funding community as partners

crm.name: GoHighLevel (Pinnacle Funding Group)
crm.note: The sales and CRM agent drafts and proposes stages until Justin says pinnacle-ghl: bot. If another agent already files and answers there, it is switched off first: two writers never write the same record.

sending.cold_email: Instantly (the existing domains, or new ones: the owner's call)

engines.note: Justin, 2026-11-24: "we sign into Claude Code CLI and Codex CLI, so we keep our costs down". Every CLI call goes through engines/route.py.

dream-100.waits_on: nothing to build the list from the rubric and draft; a first touch going out waits on the owner's yes per draft

dream-500.waits_on: nothing to build and place the list; sending waits on a sending tool and inboxes (the domain decision)

partners.waits_on: not one of the agents in this install (Justin's list, 2026-11-24). Dream 500 keeps the partner tier. On his word it becomes its own agent

cold-email.waits_on: the domain decision; the owner's charter (who, how, what a first line may say)

lead-radar.waits_on: nothing to judge its finds on Codex and hand them to the sales agent through the log

content.waits_on: a brand account per outlet and who publishes on each; the owner's content setup; any video tool is spend

speaker.waits_on: the speaker profile (name, title, topics, proof). A switch: Justin said "I wouldn't do SpeakerAgent for Find Me Money" on 2026-11-20 and listed SpeakerAgent in the Revenue OS on 2026-11-24; set state off to switch it off for this campaign

aeo-seo.source: the site (guide hub, answer pages, schema, sitemap, llms.txt; baseline: cited on 0 of 15 questions); agents/aeo-seo/, campaigns/find-me-money/settings/aeo-seo.json
aeo-seo.waits_on: Search Console and Bing verification; the tracking tool's key and the owner's yes to its cost; site changes go to the site's own repo as a pull request

sales-crm.waits_on: Codex signed in; the CRM's read-only key; Justin saying pinnacle-ghl: bot once no other agent writes there
sales-crm.combined: One process (the owner, 2026-11-17), run here as two agents from his list of 2026-11-24: Reply answers, Sales and CRM keeps the records. Both stay on test (drafts and the log) until he says pinnacle-ghl: bot.

reply_rules: no link and no 'DM me' or 'call me' in any public reply (a checker enforces it)
a first reply asks for nothing
Facebook is answered by hired posters (Justin, 2026-11-07) unless he reverses
goal: Justin, 2026-11-20: disrupt the finance industry and generate new leads from people looking to get financing the creative alternative ways. The message is campaigns/find-me-money/MESSAGING.md.
